content.title: Daily Consolidation & Experience Layer v3 Fusion Constitution — Criteria for Good Daily-Present Observations and Fork/Merge Discipline (stabilization-wave-20260531 drive)
content.summary: Schema-pack governed Research Constitution (page_type=research-constitution) for GridEngine._maintenance_loop, DurableJobSupervisor daily_consolidation phase, and experience layer v3 auto-incorporation. Defines observable quality signals for daily-present genomes produced by run_daily_consolidation_job and the precise conditions under which living-experience lineages should fork versus merge. Directly loadable by GridEngine, daily_consolidation jobs, synthesis propose_experience_evolution, and promotion paths. Self-referential: governs fusion of its own future updates into the experience layer.
core_principles: Every daily_consolidation execution produces one attributed daily-present genome (page_type=daily-present, schema-driven promotion) carrying complete fusion_checkpoint: participating_swarms, drive_think_results (gaps/contradictions/citations), graph_signals_summary, calibration_state_snapshot, experience_layer_preference=true.

Good daily-present observations are the authoritative 'all work together' role-swarm coherence artifact. High signal = high participating_swarms breadth + fusion_checkpoint completeness + KG edge emission (has_daily_present_entry, fused_from_stabilization, role_swarm_coherence_achieved) + feeds_experience_layer=true.

Living-experience lineages are forkable genome families (via Genome.fork + propose_experience_evolution). Merge (auto-incorporation) is the default for high-value deltas from calibration/graph/synthesis. Fork only on explicit high-novelty or unresolved contradiction signals.

All fusion flows through hybrid mechanism: prefer_experience_layer + source_boost (from schema page_type) + graph signals + recency + trust + calibration boosts. daily-present artifacts receive strongest boost for Conductor daily entrypoint.

Fork vs merge decisions are themselves evaluated by the constrained evolutionary search harness (see sibling constitution) before promotion. Self-referential updates to this constitution must pass the same gate.

fusion_checkpoint_must_contain: participating_swarms (min 5 from SWARM_FAMILY + central + dispatch + calibration)

fork_vs_merge_rules.default_behavior: merge (auto-incorporation via propose_experience_evolution + promotion + Genome.record_improvement into current living-experience head)
fork_conditions: Persistent high contradiction load (synthesis_contradictions > 4 after 2 daily_consolidation cycles) not resolved by merge attempt
High-novelty research thread output (new research-constitution charter or major GridEngine autonomous research advance) with future_prediction_power > 0.80
Resilience regression detected (post < pre in harness evaluation of consolidation candidate)
Explicit Conductor or form_research_org_thread directive for parallel lineage (e.g. stabilization micro-wave or adversarial branch)
Major schema evolution (new page_type family or genome schema bump) requiring separate living-experience v3.x lineage
merge_conditions: overall_goodness from MultiMetricEvaluationHarness >= 0.55 on the consolidation candidate
simplicity score >= 0.60 (no explosion of new artifacts)
No open fork directive from research-org thread or Adversary specialist
fork_vs_merge_rules.decision_capture: Every fork/merge records in target living-experience provenance.lineage + ImprovementEvent + KG research_thread or fused_from edge. Harness EvaluationScores.decision captures the outcome.

experience_layer_v3_fusion_mechanics.primary_entry: Drive.think(..., prefer_experience_layer=True) always surfaces current living-experience genome head + latest daily-present + open evolution proposals first
auto_incorporation_triggers: high-value synthesis output (low gap/contradiction, high citation)
graph hardener densification (centrality or salience edges above threshold)
calibration engine boost updates or contradiction resolutions
HealingFactor successful regeneration artifacts (post keep decision)
experience_layer_v3_fusion_mechanics.lineage_model: Versioned forkable family. Best descendants bubble via selection in hybrid fusion scoring + Conductor preference. Obsolete branches remain queryable via explicit lineage traversal but receive low boost.

framework.title: Daily Consolidation & Experience Layer v3 Fusion Constitution v1.0 — stabilization-wave-20260531
framework.description: Governs GridEngine maintenance loop daily_consolidation submissions, run_daily_consolidation_job execution, fusion_checkpoint construction, and all living-experience fork/merge decisions via propose_experience_evolution + promotion. Rules are machine-readable in framework.rules and loadable for runtime enforcement inside daily jobs and synthesis engine.

fusion_checkpoint_template.fusion_method: hybrid: drive.think(prefer_experience_layer) + synthesis + graph + calibration + role-swarm synthesis

integration_points.grid_engine: _maintenance_loop triggers supervisor.submit_queued_dream(phase='daily_consolidation') using this constitution for quality gate on produced daily-present
integration_points.durable_job_supervisor: run_daily_consolidation_job must emit daily-present payload meeting good_ criteria; auto_attributed_ingest_from_dream_job routes via page_type
integration_points.synthesis_engine: propose_experience_evolution consults fork_vs_merge_rules before emitting proposal; run_synthesis surfaces daily-present with highest boost
integration_points.drive: Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) + hybrid fusion engine enforce living-experience head selection per lineage rules
integration_points.healing_factor: successful regeneration proposals that pass harness are fused via Consolidator role using daily-present or experience-consolidation page_type
integration_points.schema_pack: daily-present and living-experience page_types + research-constitution for this charter itself receive expert_routing and high extractable signal

framework.self_referential_clause: This constitution was produced on the stabilization-wave-20260531 drive and is itself a daily-present candidate for fusion. Any future daily_consolidation or HealingFactor proposal that improves fusion quality or fork/merge discipline will be evaluated against the exact criteria defined herein by the harness. Updates merge by default unless a fork condition (e.g. new v3.1 experience layer mechanics) is met.
